description.value: The Hollow briefly channels a conductor-spirit's decades of route-knowledge. You and allies within 30 feet treat unfamiliar mechanical terrain as familiar for Perception and Survival checks for the duration. Low Toll cost.

cinderfall.incomplete: No stated numeric bonus -- the effect is a binary reclassification ("unfamiliar" -> "familiar") of PF2e's own terrain concept for Perception/Survival checks, not a flat/status/circumstance modifier. Searched specifically for a real rule-element hook for "unfamiliar terrain": the nearest real analog, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-1/terrain-stalker.json, encodes an unrelated named mechanic (undetected in a specific named terrain type via ChoiceSet+RollOption), not a familiar/unfamiliar reclassification for check DCs. No clean predicate or number to build against.
